title: What's new
description: What changed in Shortn, newest first.

2026-10-bio-newest-first.title: Newest links first on bio pages
2026-10-bio-newest-first.summary: A links section can now keep itself in order: turn on Show newest links first and links you've just created land at the top.

bioNewest.title: Newest links first
bioNewest.body: Turn it on in a links section and links are ordered by when they were created, newest at the top.

newestFirst.title: Show newest links first
newestFirst.body: In the bio editor, open a links section and turn on Show newest links first. Links are ordered by when they were created, so a link you've just created shows at the top and an older one you add takes its place by date. Turn it off to arrange them by hand again.

2026-10-bio-sorting-feedback.title: Send us feedback from the dashboard
2026-10-bio-sorting-feedback.summary: Tell us what to improve without leaving the dashboard, and follow what happens to it.

feedback.title: Feedback from the Help menu
feedback.body: Report a problem or share an idea from Help → Send feedback, and follow what happens to it.

sendFeedback.title: Send feedback
sendFeedback.body: Help → Send feedback opens a page where you can report a bug, suggest an idea or ask a question. We note which page you came from.

feedbackStatus.title: See where your feedback stands
feedbackStatus.body: The feedback page lists what you've sent and its status: received, under review, planned, done or not planned.

2026-10-new-shortn.title: The new Shortn
2026-10-new-shortn.summary: We rebuilt Shortn from the ground up: a faster dashboard with a page for every task, built for libraries with thousands of links. Your account, links, QR codes and bio pages came with you, and everything you've shared keeps working.

dashboard.title: A new dashboard at app.shortn.at
dashboard.body: Faster, with a page for every task, and search, filters and bulk actions that hold up with thousands of links.

links.title: More control over every link
links.body: Custom keys, tags, UTM variants, passwords, schedules, targeting rules, app links and weekly destination checks.

qr.title: QR codes made for print
qr.body: Designs with logos and frames, SVG, PNG and PDF exports, and scans counted separately from clicks.

bio.title: Bio pages at their own address
bio.body: Each page now lives at handle.shortn.at, with themes and blocks. Old shortn.at/b/ links redirect there.

developers.title: An API, webhooks and an MCP server
developers.body: Connect Shortn to your own systems and to AI assistants.

home.title: A new home at app.shortn.at
home.body: Sign in with your existing account; your workspaces, links and QR codes are already there.

pages.title: A page for every task
pages.body: Creating, editing and deleting each have their own page and address, so the back button, bookmarks and shared links all work.

library.title: Built for large libraries
library.body: Search plus tag, status and date filters, with server-side pages, keep thousands of links quick. Select across pages and filters, then archive, tag, move to a campaign or delete up to 500 at once.

keyboard.title: Keyboard shortcuts and a command palette
keyboard.body: Press ? for the shortcuts and ⌘K or Ctrl+K to jump anywhere.

languages.title: Light or dark, in three languages
languages.body: Choose a light, dark or system theme, in English, Portuguese or Spanish.

customKeys.title: Custom keys
customKeys.body: Choose the part after the slash yourself. Renamed keys keep redirecting.

tags.title: Tags
tags.body: File links under tags and filter the library by them.

utm.title: UTM variants
utm.body: Tagged versions of a link for each channel, counted by source, medium and campaign.

password.title: Password protection
password.body: Ask for a password before redirecting, with an optional hint.

rules.title: Schedules, limits and targeting
rules.body: Set when a link starts and stops working, cap its visits, send visitors to different destinations by country or device, or split traffic by weight.

appLinks.title: App links
appLinks.body: Open the iOS or Android app directly, falling back to the web or the app store.

preview.title: Social previews
preview.body: Set the title, description and image that link previews show.

health.title: Destination health
health.body: Weekly checks flag destinations that keep returning errors, in the list and on the link's page.

archive.title: Archive and trash
archive.body: Archive links to clear the list without deleting them. Deleted links can be restored for 30 days.

dynamic.title: Change destinations after printing
dynamic.body: Every code has its own short link, so printed copies follow when you change where it goes.

design.title: Designs
design.body: Colours, dot and corner shapes, frames and captions, with a live check that the code still scans.

logo.title: Logos
logo.body: Put your logo in the centre of the code.

qrExports.title: Print exports
qrExports.body: SVG, PNG or PDF at the size you need, one code at a time or many as a ZIP.

scans.title: Scans counted separately
scans.body: Scans have their own numbers, apart from clicks. Scans of older QR codes that were recorded as clicks now count as scans.

address.title: Your own address
address.body: Each bio page lives at handle.shortn.at. Old shortn.at/b/ links redirect there.

blocks.title: Themes and blocks
blocks.body: Start from a theme, then add links, social icons, text, images, embeds and QR codes, and drag sections into order.

collections.title: Link collections
collections.body: Show long lists of links as a list, squares or image cards, split into pages for visitors.

drafts.title: Drafts and history
drafts.body: Edits stay in a draft until you publish, and earlier versions can be restored.

overview.title: Clicks and scans in one view
overview.body: Analytics for the workspace, a link, a QR code or a campaign, compared with the previous period. Filters live in the address, so views can be bookmarked and shared.

breakdowns.title: Breakdowns and filters
breakdowns.body: Countries, cities, referrers, devices, browsers, operating systems and UTM tags. Click a row to filter by it.

analyticsExports.title: Analytics exports
analyticsExports.body: Export the raw events as CSV in the background and download them when they're ready.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.body: Group links under a campaign, build UTM-tagged links for each channel and read the results together.

campaignExports.title: Campaign exports
campaignExports.body: Export a campaign's events as CSV.

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.body: Use your own domain for links or a bio page. Each custom-domain add-on includes one domain.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.body: Keep brands or clients apart in separate workspaces and switch between them.

roles.title: Members and roles
roles.body: Invite people as admins, members or viewers, and choose what each person can do.

api.title: REST API
api.body: Manage links, QR codes, bio pages, tags, campaigns and analytics from your own code with scoped API keys.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Receive events at your endpoint when links and other resources change, with delivery history and redelivery.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.body: Let AI assistants work with your links through the Model Context Protocol.

imports.title: Imports
imports.body: Bring in links or QR codes from a CSV file or a pasted list, with a dry run before anything is created.

linkExports.title: Link exports
linkExports.body: Export filtered links as CSV and import them back later.

workspaceExport.title: Workspace export
workspaceExport.body: Download a private copy of everything in a workspace.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication and passkeys
twoFactor.body: Add an authenticator app or a passkey to your account. Both are being switched on workspace by workspace.

sso.title: Workplace SSO
sso.body: Let members sign in through your company's identity provider over OIDC or SAML.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: See where you're signed in and sign out other devices.

plans.title: Plan changes
plans.body: Upgrade or downgrade from Billing. Upgrades apply right away and are prorated; downgrades take effect at the end of the period.

invoices.title: Invoices and receipts
invoices.body: Download invoices from Billing. Receipts, refunds and failed-payment details arrive by email.

currency.title: Euro estimates
currency.body: Plans are billed in US dollars, with a euro estimate based on ECB reference rates.
